run_test_suite_with_runner: run a test suite using the Runner class with optional dedicated threads for each test case
capture_stdout_stderr_with_capturefile: capture stdout or stderr output by using CaptureFile as a context manager around test execution
create_augmented_case_with_uuid: create an AugmentedCase namedtuple wrapping a unittest TestCase with a unique UUID identifier
skip_tests_in_runner: skip specific tests by calling skip_tests on the Runner with a list of test ID substrings
review_runner_signal_handlers: review the Runner class signal handlers for SIGINT, SIGBUS, SIGABRT, SIGFPE, SIGILL, and SIGPIPE
